C1.claim: Tail-SD improves CV3 completion over Base.
C1.supported_wording: On the CV3 E11 panel, Tail-SD improved strict completion over Base by 11.20 pp (95% CI 8.70 to 13.80).

C2.supported_wording: At the matched aggregate active-label budget, terminal placement exceeded Random-Local by 4.50 pp.

C3.supported_wording: Tail-SD retained a positive advantage when K_i, EOS/special positions, CE denominator, targets and histories were matched per record.
C3.identity_limit: Fixed trained checkpoints and sampled masks.

C4.claim: Placement advantage persists across tested initialization and mask draws.
C4.supported_wording: The placement advantage kept the same direction across the tested paired initializations and additional frozen random-span realizations.
C4.identity_limit: Finite sensitivity analysis; cells share Tail-SD checkpoints and masks.

C5.supported_wording: On the shared/open E11 panel, Tail-SD exceeded Random-PR on CosyVoice2 by 2.90 pp (95% CI 0.80 to 5.10) using an independently constructed E08 training bank.
C5.identity_limit: Same CosyVoice family; evaluation panel shared with CV3.

C6.claim: E13 reproduces the placement advantage on a new unopened panel.
C6.supported_wording: Across six matched Tail-SD minus Random-PR contrasts, the unopened E13 panel gave a mean +4.70 pp advantage (95% CI 3.20 to 6.22), with six of six positive.

C7.claim: Tail supervision outperforms deterministic Head and Middle placement.
C7.supported_wording: On the opened E13 panel, Tail-SD exceeded Head-PR by 16.45 pp and Middle-PR by 9.50 pp under exact per-record supervision matching.
prohibited_wording: Tail is optimal at every possible position
C7.identity_limit: Post-hoc mechanism study on already-opened E13.

C8.supported_wording: Fixed-ratio terminal tails implement placement without per-record loss-boundary localization while preserving full teacher-forced history.
C8.identity_limit: Implementation simplification in the tested contract.

C9.supported_wording: Tail-SD achieved 68.2% versus 67.8% for Full-SD; the paired +0.40 pp comparison had a 95% CI from -1.90 to +2.70 and did not establish a difference.
C9.identity_limit: No equivalence or non-inferiority test was performed.

C10.supported_wording: In E13, strict completion remained near zero in the 160-180-word bin across systems.
C10.identity_limit: Descriptive result for the tested panel and length bin.

C11.claim: Terminal-placement advantage persists across the tested direct-supervision budgets.
C11.supported_wording: On the opened E13 panel, Tail-SD exceeded per-record-matched Random-PR at 12.98%, 25.9%, and 51.77% active-label participation; the aggregate differences were +4.55, +4.70, and +2.50 pp, respectively.
prohibited_wording: the effect is monotonic in budget
active-label ratio is compute, FLOPs, or time saving
Full-SD is the 100% Tail budget point
C11.identity_limit: Post-hoc sensitivity analysis on the already-opened E13 panel; only three tested working points.

C12.claim: E15 provides only a descriptive fixed-prefix termination diagnostic.
C12.supported_wording: Tail-SD showed larger fixed-prefix EOS-logit separation than Base, Head-PR, and Middle-PR, but the preregistered complete mechanism criterion was not satisfied.
prohibited_wording: EOS behavior explains the completion gain
C12.identity_limit: Post-hoc descriptive diagnostic on opened E13; 12 cross-stratum sources were not jointly clustered by the existing bootstrap.
